```{r}
resources <- read.csv("data/resources.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
estimates <- read.csv("data/resource_estimates.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
pipelines <- read.csv("data/pipelines.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
source("R/tool_ranges.R")
source("R/resource_score.R")
resources <- merge(
  merge(resources, estimates, by = "pipeline_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE),
  pipelines[, c("pipeline_id", "name")],
  by = "pipeline_id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
resources$ram_max_gb <- vapply(resources$estimated_ram_range, max_range_gb, numeric(1))
resources$database_max_gb <- vapply(resources$estimated_database_storage, max_range_gb, numeric(1))
resources$results_max_gb <- vapply(resources$estimated_sample_storage, max_range_gb, numeric(1))
resources$evidence_context <- paste(
  resources$resource_evidence_type, resources$context, resources$estimate_basis, sep = "; "
)
resources <- resource_score(resources)
catalog <- resources[, c(
  "name", "score", "estimated_ram_range", "relative_speed", "estimated_database_storage",
  "estimated_sample_storage", "cpu_hours_or_elapsed", "evidence_context", "ram_max_gb",
  "speed_rank", "database_max_gb", "results_max_gb"
)]
names(catalog) <- c(
  "Pipeline", "Score", "RAM range", "Relative speed", "Database disk",
  "Sample/result disk", "CPU-hours / elapsed", "Evidence and context", "ram_max_gb",
  "speed_rank", "database_max_gb", "results_max_gb"
)
```


```{r}
DT::datatable(
  catalog,
  elementId = "resource-catalogue",
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  escape = 1:8,
  class = "compact stripe resource-table",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 100,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
    scrollX = FALSE,
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    order = list(list(1, "desc")),
    dom = '<"resource-table-search"f>rt<"resource-table-footer"lip>',
    columnDefs = list(
      list(width = "10%", targets = 0),
      list(width = "5%", targets = 1),
      list(width = "15%", targets = 2),
      list(width = "7%", targets = 3),
      list(width = "14%", targets = 4),
      list(width = "14%", targets = 5),
      list(width = "10%", targets = 6),
      list(width = "25%", targets = 7),
      list(orderData = 8, targets = 2),
      list(orderData = 9, targets = 3),
      list(orderData = 10, targets = 4),
      list(orderData = 11, targets = 5),
      list(visible = FALSE, targets = 8:11)
    )
  )
) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    "Score",
    color = "transparent",
    background = DT::styleColorBar(c(0, 1), "#8bb7a8", angle = 270),
    backgroundSize = "100% 12px",
    backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
    backgroundPosition = "left center"
  ) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    "RAM range",
    valueColumns = "ram_max_gb",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(c(4, 16, 64), c("#d5eee7", "#e7edf4", "#f6e8c8", "#e7b7ad"))
  ) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    "Relative speed",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
      c("High", "Medium", "Low-Medium", "Low", "N/A"),
      c("#d5eee7", "#e7edf4", "#f6e8c8", "#e7b7ad", "#f1f1ef")
    )
  ) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    "Database disk",
    valueColumns = "database_max_gb",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(c(0, 1, 10, 100), c("#f1f1ef", "#d5eee7", "#e7edf4", "#f6e8c8", "#e7b7ad"))
  ) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    "Sample/result disk",
    valueColumns = "results_max_gb",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(c(0, 1, 10, 100), c("#f1f1ef", "#d5eee7", "#e7edf4", "#f6e8c8", "#e7b7ad"))
  )
```

Long range and context text is clipped to keep rows a consistent height; the complete values remain in the editable CSV files.

The score is a relative resource-efficiency index: RAM and database-disk maxima are ranked within this pipeline set with lower use scoring higher, and speed rank favors faster workflows. The three components are averaged on a 0–1 scale; unavailable RAM or database bounds receive a neutral midpoint. It is a planning aid, not a performance benchmark. Range columns retain their text summaries, sort by their largest numeric bound in GB, and use that bound for background shading. Approximate ranges are provided in `resource_estimates.csv` where literature measurements are absent; unavailable values remain uncolored. Speed sorts by meaning (Low < Low-Medium < Medium < High), not alphabetically.

Wall-clock time is not converted to CPU-hours unless core utilization is reported. `Not reported` means the reviewed sources did not support a defensible value.
